scope: initial measured improvement on authored family-disjoint English evaluation, not production or coding savings
train_sources: families.json train; prior viewed final data now development
selection: Validation NLL only on fixed-class outputs; both seeds frozen before final
failure_policy: Do not lower criteria; a viewed test becomes development data, require a new family holdout for a new cycle. Preserve all failures.
feature_pool: Mean of non-special state-only token embeddings from frozen Laya encoder, FP32, max 512 tokens
permutation_policy: No choice-list input. Fixed class outputs preserve labels under serialization permutations by construction. This is NOT repaired robustness of the original Laya choice head.
calibration_policy: 24 development calibration cases, same .5..5 temperature grid for base and tuned
